speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC)

The biopsy results showing nuclear hyperchromasia, multinucleation, and increased mitotic figures within follicular epithelium are classic histological indicators of malignancy, specifically squamous cell carcinoma. The negative STD panel rules out syphilitic or viral etiologies like HPV-associated lesions. Given the aggressive cellular features, I recommend immediate excisional biopsy with clear margins and staging evaluation.
